A song of ascents. Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!
Happy is the worshipper of the Lord, who is walking in his ways.
（上行之詩。）凡敬畏耶和華、遵行他道的人便為有福！
For when you eat the fruit of your labor, blessings and prosperity will be yours.
You will have the fruit of the work of your hands: happy will you be, and all will be well for you.
你要吃勞碌得來的；你要享福，事情順利。
Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table.
Your wife will be like a fertile vine in the inmost parts of your house: your children will be like olive plants round your table.
你妻子在你的內室，好像多結果子的葡萄樹；你兒女圍繞你的桌子，好像橄欖栽子。
In this way indeed shall blessing come to the man who fears the LORD.
See! this is the blessing of the worshipper of the Lord.
看哪，敬畏耶和華的人必要這樣蒙福！
May the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life,
May the Lord send you blessing out of Zion: may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
願耶和華從錫安賜福給你！願你一生一世看見耶路撒冷的好處！
that you may see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel!
May you see your children's children. Peace be on Israel.
願你看見你兒女的兒女！願平安歸於以色列！
